data.body_html:
Capture the magic of golden hour on the Mediterranean with a sunset photoshoot yacht session in Marbella. Depart from Puerto Banús aboard a luxury vessel – choose from our fleet of 12.5m to 29m yachts – and enjoy uninterrupted views of the Costa del Sol coastline as the sun dips behind La Concha. Whether you’re a professional photographer, influencer, or simply want stunning holiday memories, this 2-hour charter includes skipper, drinks, snacks, and all taxes. Prices from €749 for the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39.

Our [Marbella yacht charter](/experiences/) experiences are designed for comfort and style, with no hidden extras. Just bring your camera and let the golden light do the rest.

Why Choose a Sunset Photoshoot Yacht Session in Marbella?

Marbella’s golden hour is legendary – warm light, calm seas, and a backdrop of the Sierra Blanca mountains. A private yacht gives you exclusive access to the best angles: the Puerto Banús marina, the Golden Mile villas, and the rugged coastline towards Cabopino. Unlike crowded beach spots, you’ll have the sea to yourself. Our yachts are well-maintained, with spacious decks perfect for group shots or intimate portraits. The included drinks and snacks keep everyone refreshed while you shoot.

Which Yachts Are Best for a Photoshoot?

For a 2-hour sunset session, we recommend the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) or Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) – both priced at €749 for 2 hours (all inclusive). If you need more space or a larger deck, consider the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) from €4,719 for 4 hours (includes a jet ski). Other options include the Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax), Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax), or Maiora 26m (26m, 12 pax) – pricing on request via WhatsApp. All depart from Puerto Banús and include skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks.

What’s Included in Your Sunset Session?

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, safety equipment, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks. Spanish IVA (21%) is included – no surprises. You can bring your own photographer or use your phone. The yacht will anchor at a scenic spot near the coast, offering views of Marbella Marina, La Concha, and the golden horizon.

Ideal Itinerary for Golden Hour Photography

Your 2-hour session typically departs 1.5 hours before sunset. Cruise along the coast towards Cabopino or Estepona, with stops for photos against the setting sun. The calm evening sea provides stable conditions for shooting. Return to Puerto Banús as the lights of the marina begin to twinkle – a perfect final shot.

Who Is This Experience For?

Perfect for couples, engagement shoots, influencer content, brand campaigns, or small groups celebrating a special occasion. The yacht’s open decks and flybridge offer versatile backdrops. Non-photographers are welcome too – simply enjoy the sunset with a glass of cava.

How to Book Your Photoshoot Yacht Session

Contact us via WhatsApp or our booking page. Tell us your preferred date, yacht size, and guest count. We’ll confirm availability and send a secure payment link. Prices start from €749 for 2 hours. For larger yachts or longer durations, we’ll provide a custom quote. Book early – sunset slots are popular.
